theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (e : AddChar (ZMod N) R) (χ : DirichletCharacter R N) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∣ N) (he : e.mulShift ↑d = 1) {u : (ZMod N)ˣ} (hu : (ZMod.unitsMap hd) u = 1) : χ ↑u * gaussSum χ e = gaussSum χ e := by
  let χ' := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel hd χ
  have hχ' : χ' : MulChar (ZMod d) R := by
    rw [DirichletCharacter.changeLevel_def hd χ]
    constructor
    · exact (DirichletCharacter.toUnitHom_eq_char' χ hd).trans (ZMod.unitsMap_comp_unitsMap hd hd)
    · exact (DirichletCharacter.toUnitHom_eq_char' χ hd).trans (ZMod.unitsMap_comp_unitsMap hd hd)
  let e' := e.mulShift ↑d
  have h_e': e' = 1 := he
  have h_gauss_shift : gaussSum χ e = χ⁻¹ ↑d * gaussSum χ e :=
    gaussSum_mulShift_eq χ e ↑d
  have h_chi_u: χ ↑u = 1 :=
    by
      rw [DirichletCharacter.toUnitHom_eq_char' χ hd]
      exact (ZMod.unitsMap_comp_unitsMap hd hd).trans hu
  rw [h_gauss_shift, h_chi_u, mul_one]
